"We are making history": Trump, Xi, and Putin hold trilateral talks in China . Xi Jinping said China, Russia, and the US must cooperate to address global challenges, warning that a war between major powers would plunge the world into chaos. He called for joint efforts to safeguard global peace and stability. Donald Trump said the talks would "solve all the world's problems" and that the leaders were "making history." He stressed the importance of discussing global disputes and highlighted "unique opportunities" to address nuclear weapons, despite China's reluctance to discuss the issue. Vladimir Putin said the three countries could strengthen global stability through constructive cooperation. He proposed discussing global and regional issues, energy security, international terrorism, and transnational organized crime.
